output.reason: On its own, the cited bullet [ev-1a930b2ae9f7] is only a metric name. Its section intro [ev-1f419676f177] supplies what is missing. It says the listed metrics, including `cortex_ring_tokens_total`, will change from the `cortex_` prefix to `loki_` in 3.0.0. The old name can be kept by changing `metrics_namespace` from its default `loki` to `cortex`, and that setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. That is enough to write the assertion: the subject is the metric, the change is a rename to `loki_ring_tokens_total`, exposed environments are those where `metrics_namespace` is not set to `cortex`, and anything that reads the old metric name stops getting data.
